metadata.title: Maryland local data-center operating environment

status_definition.restricted: A moratorium, prohibition, or administrative halt currently restricts new data-center activity.
status_definition.pending_action: A formal restrictive action has been proposed but is not in effect.
status_definition.operating: At least one confirmed operating facility is inventoried and no current restriction or pending action is identified.
status_definition.open: No current restriction or pending action and no confirmed operating facility are identified.

metadata.geometry_source: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb county boundaries, via power-estimates.json
metadata.policy_method: Restrictions and proposals are curated from primary local government records. Operating status is derived from confirmed operating records in infrastructure.json. Restrictions take precedence over pending action, then operating presence, then open status.
